segment.source: Renders a capability with its poster frame and a play control that opens the recording in an overlay, so the page stays light until somebody asks for the film. Use it for: product walkthroughs, release demos, tutorial sections, webinar excerpts embedded in a feature page, training material. Prefer 'Annotated Screenshot' when a still with a legend explains it faster, and 'Feature Showcase Row' when there is no recording to show.
